item.title: Editorial: How not to diminish God’s image
item.description: In the beginning, we were created in God’s image. Rather than diminish God’s image in each other, let’s see it and celebrate it.

item.title: Celebrating Churches: Martin celebrates 10 years at FBC Ropesville
item.description: Donovan Martin is celebrating 10 years as senior pastor of First Baptist Church, Ropes in Ropesville. Martin was called to the church in February 2016.

item.title: Fewer Latin Americans claim religion but still pray and believe
item.description: The number of Latin Americans who say they are not affiliated with a religion has been increasing. For many, that label doesn’t mean a rejection of faith.

item.title: Equip: Resources on the Book of Obadiah
item.description: Joshua Sharp recommends a set of resources for studying, preaching, and teaching Obadiah—perhaps the Bible’s most neglected book.

item.title: Churches burned in 2006 mark 20 years of God’s blessings
item.description: More than 100 people from Alabama and Mississippi gathered recently at Galilee Missionary Baptist Church in Panola to mark the 20th anniversary of what Pastor Bob Little calls “a blessing in the blaze.”

item.title: Around the State: UMHB announces plans for new science lab
item.description: The University of Mary Hardin-Baylor is excited to announce plans to build a new 56,032-square-foot science lab facility located on the corner of Martin Luther King Jr. Avenue and College Street.

item.title: Millennial/Gen Z Network is ‘revolutionary’
item.description: The Pastor’s Common is a Texas Baptists ministry providing opportunities for emerging ministry leaders to be heard and find community.

item.title: Review: Beatitudes and Terror
item.description: Editor Eric Black reviews "Beatitudes and Terror," a commentary by Ukrainian scholars on the Beatitudes in the Sermon on the Mount.

item.title: Commentary: When the church picks teams
item.description: In response to Christians choosing political sides, Nick Acker calls them back to unified love and community as Christian witness.

item.title: Jesse Jackson, civil rights leader, dies at 84
item.description: The Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr., civil rights activist who twice vied for the Democratic presidential nomination, died Feb. 17 at age 84.
